如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    苏柔等人离开后，大殿陷入沉寂。
过了许久，殿外才传来急促的踩踏之音，一位弟子飞速的跑了进来。
此人乃是段宇轩，但此刻的他与进入地宫前相比，简直判若两人。
发丝凌乱，满头大汗，大口大口的喘着粗气，如同发疯一般直奔高台飞奔而去。
“哈哈，第一终究是我的，杨天雨你个小屁孩，也想和我争？”
“你当老子隐忍在外门足足六年，是为了什么？我现在告诉你，老子为的就是他妈这些。”
段宇轩一边奔跑，一边欢呼，如同着了魔一般，目光紧紧的凝视高台，竟忽视了大殿内的凶兽尸体。
“唰。”他一跃而起，稳稳的落在了高台之上。
可当他满脸笑容，将目光扫向脚下之后，却如晴天霹雳，顿时傻眼。
因为在那高台之上，竟然空空如也，连根毛都没有。
“靠，什么情况？”
良久之后，他才回过神来，这才发现高台的下方，竟满是鲜血，足足四十只凶兽的尸体，散落在大殿各处。
并且每只凶兽的死状，那都是惊心动魄，血腥至极。
这一幕，将他吓坏了，竟噗通一下坐在了高台上，回头观望，这才发现那通过考核的大门，竟然并未“这究竟是怎么回事？”段宇轩有些不知所措，他的思绪瞬间凌乱了。
“踏踏踏…”就在这时，杨天雨也跑了过来，可是他刚到大殿门口，便停住了。
看着大殿内的一幕，又看了眼高台之上的段宇轩，他目瞪口呆：“这..这是你做的？”
段宇轩轻笑一声，苦逼的道：“如果我说不是，你信么？”
“当然信，你不可能有这么强的实力。”杨天雨撇了他一眼，便走入大殿，查看起凶兽的尸体：“天哪，竟然还有一只四阶凶兽，这究竟是谁的手笔？”
二人观察良久，但始终未能得出答案，他们想不出在外门之中，什么人会有这么恐怖的实力。
到得最后，他们甚至怀疑，这是长老们设下的局，是长老吞掉了第一名的奖励。

可是当灵武三重的弟子大军赶到后，戏剧性的一幕发生了。
所有人都认为，是杨天雨和段宇轩击杀了那些凶兽，而至于第一名的奖励，则被他们两个平分了。
但最好笑的是，面对众人那崇拜的目光，杨天雨和段宇轩竟然并未否认，就这样莫名其妙的成了第一名。
大门被，他们就成为了内门弟子，迎来了新的人生。
可就在人们欢呼雀跃之际，一名自地宫走出的少年，引起了人们的注意。
他一丝不挂，竟在哭泣，满腹委屈的咒骂着：“谁他妈这么缺德，背后打我一闷棍不说，还扒了人家衣服，哪有这么变态的？”
对于这样一幕，人们都是很是诧异，唯有楚枫微微一笑，打量了一下身上完好无损的衣服，悄悄离开了人群。
内门考核落幕，参加考核者上万人，通过考核者只有两千人，但这已不是一个小数目。
进入内门，才算正式的成为了青龙宗的弟子，同时也享受到了优越的待遇。
为了欢迎新弟子加入内门，长老们还特意搞了一场盛宴。
夜空之上圆月高挂，内门之中歌舞升平，将那喜悦的气氛衬托到了极致。
不过这场盛宴楚枫却未参加，而是待在自己新的府邸内，赤着上身，观察自己的伤口。
那伤口正在愈合，并且愈合的很快，这样下去，只要几日便可以彻底痊愈，而这样的恢复能力，正是那神雷赐予的。
“你究竟是什么？为何要选择我？”
这个问题，不是楚枫第一次问了，他曾无数次问过这个问题，但却始终未曾得到过答案。
他仍记得五年前的夜里，青州上空，被九色神雷笼罩。
天空明亮如白昼，雷霆舞动如蛟龙，天有雷鸣咆哮，大地不住颤抖，人们皆以为末日降临，恐慌之际，混乱一片。
可只有十岁的楚枫，却不由自主的跑出了家门，前往了一处空旷之地。
就连现在，他也不知道，当初为什么会那么做，就像是有种魔力在吸引着他前往那里。
至于后来，他便被神雷附体了。

没有人见到那一幕，但他却知道丹田内的，一定是那轰动了整片大陆的，九色神雷。
那神雷虽赐予了楚枫强大的体魄，但楚枫却始终不明白，这样厉害的东西，为何要附在他的体内。

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s copyright complaint fast track. After Su Rou and others left, the hall fell into silence.
After a long time, there was a rapid stampede sound outside the hall, and a disciple ran in quickly.
This person is Duan Yuxuan, but at this moment he is completely different from what he was before entering the underground palace.
His hair was messy, he was sweating profusely, he was panting heavily, and he ran straight to the high platform as if he was crazy.
"Haha, the first place is mine after all. Yang Tianyu, you little brat, you want to compete with me?"
"Why do you think I have been hiding in the outer sect for six years? I'm telling you now, this is all I want."
Duan Yuxuan was running and cheering, as if he was possessed, staring closely at the high platform, and actually ignored the corpse of the ferocious beast in the hall.
"Whoa." He jumped up and landed firmly on the high platform.
But when he looked down at his feet with a smile on his face, he was stunned like a bolt from the blue.
Because on that high platform, it was completely empty, not even a hair on it.
"Damn, what's going on?"
After a long time, he came back to his senses and discovered that the bottom of the high platform was covered with blood, and the corpses of forty ferocious beasts were scattered throughout the hall.
And the death of each ferocious beast was thrilling and extremely bloody.
This scene frightened him so much that he sat down on the high platform and turned around to look around. Only then did he realize that the door that had passed the examination did not. "What on earth is going on?" Duan Yuxuan was a little at a loss, and his thoughts were instantly messed up.
"Tap tap tap..." At this moment, Yang Tianyu also ran over, but he stopped as soon as he reached the entrance of the hall.
Looking at the scene in the hall, and then looking at Duan Yuxuan on the high platform, he was stunned: "This...did you do this?"
Duan Yuxuan chuckled and said bitterly: "If I say no, do you believe it?"
"Of course I believe it. You can't be so strong." Yang Tianyu glanced at him, then walked into the hall and looked at the corpse of the beast: "Oh my God, there is a fourth-level beast. Whose handiwork is this?"
The two of them observed for a long time, but still could not come up with an answer. They could not figure out who among the outer sect could have such terrifying strength.
In the end, they even suspected that this was a trap set by the elders, who had swallowed the first place reward.
But when the army of third-level Lingwu disciples arrived, a dramatic scene happened.
Everyone believed that it was Yang Tianyu and Duan Yuxuan who killed those ferocious beasts, and the first place reward was divided equally between the two of them.
But the funniest thing is that in the face of everyone's admiring gazes, Yang Tianyu and Duan Yuxuan did not deny it, and thus became the number one inexplicably.
Once the gate is closed, they become inner disciples and usher in a new life.
But just as people were cheering, a young man walking out of the underground palace attracted people's attention.
He was naked, crying, and cursing full of grievances: "Who is so damn wicked? Not only did he beat me from behind, but he also took off other people's clothes. How could he be so perverted?"
Everyone was very surprised at such a scene. Only Chu Feng smiled slightly, looked at his intact clothes, and quietly left the crowd.
The inner sect assessment has come to an end. Tens of thousands of people participated in the assessment, and only two thousand people passed the assessment, but this is no longer a small number.
Only when you enter the inner sect can you officially become a disciple of the Qinglong Sect, and you will also enjoy superior treatment.
In order to welcome the new disciples to join the inner sect, the elders specially held a feast.
The full moon hung high in the night sky, and singing and dancing in the inner door brought the joyful atmosphere to the extreme.
However, Chu Feng did not participate in this feast. Instead, he stayed in his new residence, shirtless, observing his wounds.
That wound isHealing, and healing very quickly, if this continues, it will only take a few days to fully recover, and this kind of recovery ability is given by the divine thunder.
"Who are you? Why did you choose me?"
This is not the first time Chu Feng has asked this question. He has asked this question countless times, but has never received an answer.
He still remembered the night five years ago when the sky above Qingzhou was shrouded by nine-color divine thunder.
The sky was as bright as day, the thunder danced like a dragon, thunder roared in the sky, and the earth couldn't help but tremble. People all thought that the end was coming, and chaos arose in panic.
But Chu Feng, who was only ten years old, ran out of his house involuntarily and headed to an open place.
Even now, he doesn't know why he did that in the first place. It's like there is some kind of magic that attracts him to go there.
As for later, he was possessed by the divine thunder.
No one saw that scene, but he knew that what was in the dantian must be the nine-color divine thunder that shocked the entire continent.
Although the divine thunder gave Chu Feng a powerful body, Chu Feng still didn't understand why such a powerful thing was attached to his body.
